payload.name: Brandon Foster
payload.title: Senior Platform & MLOps Engineer
payload.headline: Building high-throughput distributed systems, sovereign AI infrastructure, and autonomous agent workflows.
payload.summary: Senior Platform, Distributed Systems, and MLOps Engineer with deep expertise in architecting cloud-native infrastructure, high-concurrency microservices, and AI-powered systems. Specialized in Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), GitOps (ArgoCD), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), enterprise streaming platforms (Kafka/Confluent), zero-trust security (mTLS, App Mesh), and local/production AI agent architectures. Proven track record leading multi-account cloud consolidations, large-scale Bitbucket-to-GitHub migrations, and saving over $10K/month in cloud FinOps optimizations.
domains: Distributed Systems & Service Mesh (Kubernetes, AWS App Mesh, mTLS)
AI Infrastructure & MLOps (Local LLMs, Agentic Teams, RAG Pipelines)
Data Platforms & Streaming (Kafka, Confluent Cloud, Snowflake, Databricks)
